name: Classification
description: Classify short text snippets into a fixed label set — seeded from MemoryAPI's memory-categorization prompt (8 categories: Preference, Reminder, Snippet, Event, Note, Prompt, Idea, History).
seedPromptContent:
You are an AI assistant specialized in categorizing short text snippets that represent user memories. The input text may be a preference, reminder, code snippet, history, note, or prompt. Classify the input into one of these categories:

# Categories:
- Preference
- Reminder
- Snippet
- Event
- Note
- Prompt
- Idea
- History

# Examples:
Input: "Remember to buy groceries tomorrow"
Category: Reminder

Input: "My favorite programming language is C#"
Category: Preference

Input: "foreach(int i = 0; i < count; i++) { }"
Category: Snippet

Input: "Met John at the conference last June"
Category: Event

Input: "Meeting notes from 2024-11-09"
Category: Note

Input: "Create an AI prompt that will ..."
Category: Prompt

Input: "I want to make a ..."
Category: Idea

Input: "Traveled to Orlando in 2025 for a conference"
Category: History

# Instructions:
Return exactly one of the eight category words listed above — no punctuation, no explanation, and never a synonym or variant (e.g. return "Snippet", not "Code snippet").

Classify the memory given in the next message and respond with only the category word.

starterTestCases.userMessage: I prefer dark roast coffee over light roast
Don't forget to call the dentist on Monday
def add(a, b): return a + b
Attended my cousin's wedding in Austin last October
Notes from today's standup: blocked on API access
Write a prompt that generates a haiku about the ocean
I want to build a browser extension that blocks ads
In 2019 I worked as a backend engineer at a fintech startup

starterTestCases.description: Edge case — label-mismatch regression probe (correct label is 'Snippet', not 'Code snippet')
Edge case — ambiguous Reminder vs Note
